      app: adservice

      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 5
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000

        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000

      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:

        image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/adservice:v0.10.3

        - containerPort: 9555

          limits:

            memory: 300Mi

          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 9555
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 9555
